requestSequence: run the fixed vinext build in a clean output tree
cases.observation: the formal locator, Worker config, server module graph, and client assets are present with no stale files
cases.selectionReason: the production artifact is the common input to both providers

requestSequence: build twice from the same fixed source path after removing both output trees
cases.observation: record whether relative output names, bytes, and SHA-256 inventory drift across source builds
cases.selectionReason: Cloudflare assigns identity when an artifact is uploaded as a Worker Version; it does not require two source builds to be byte-identical

requestSequence: import the generated locator and formal Worker config without rebundling
cases.observation: entry, reachable modules, assets routing, Cache, Images, and Version Metadata match the generated semantics
cases.selectionReason: open-compute must consume the same production artifact

requestSequence: compare generated logical binding declarations with local resource mappings
cases.observation: name, kind, and class semantics match bidirectionally while provider IDs do not enter tenant bytes
cases.selectionReason: generated provider identities cannot be local authority

requestSequence: upload one frozen artifact as an immutable version
activate it through the provider deployment model
cases.observation: the frozen bytes have one immutable version/deployment identity and the active route serves that identity
cases.selectionReason: deployment immutability owns framework artifact admission

requestSequence: request the App Router SSR root and a status-selecting Route Handler
cases.observation: HTML/body markers, selected status, content type, and proxy/route headers match
cases.selectionReason: representative App Router production HTTP path

cases.observation: shell precedes delayed content without full-page buffering
cases.selectionReason: stream ordering is not proven by final-body assertions

cases.cloudflareSupportCategory: App Router and React Server Components
requestSequence: interact with a hydrated client component
cases.observation: the client counter hydrates and updates without unexpected console or page errors
cases.selectionReason: browser execution proves server/client artifact coherence

cases.observation: HTML and RSC variants remain distinct and server-only data is absent from client-visible bytes
cases.selectionReason: RSC is a primary Cloudflare-supported vinext path

requestSequence: submit the fixed Server Action form
observe its request, redirect target, result, and HttpOnly cookie
cases.observation: the action request executes once and the redirected result and cookie match
cases.selectionReason: Cloudflare lists Server Actions as supported

requestSequence: request the status Route Handler with valid and invalid values through proxy.ts
cases.observation: status validation, routing, proxy header, route header, and JSON body match
cases.selectionReason: proxy.ts is the Next.js 16 request-boundary representative

requestSequence: extract and request a referenced immutable client chunk
cases.observation: title, description, chunk URL, status, and immutable asset bytes are coherent
cases.selectionReason: client execution depends on exact immutable assets

cases.observation: GSSP marker, proxy header, API status, route header, and JSON body match
cases.selectionReason: Pages Router must be proven independently from App Router

cases.observation: GSP and getStaticPaths outputs, fallback, and 404 semantics match
cases.selectionReason: Cloudflare lists static generation and Pages Router as supported

cases.observation: static bytes, MIME, and 404 routing match
cases.selectionReason: formal Assets routing owns static output delivery

cases.cloudflareSupportCategory: Static generation and React Server Components
requestSequence: request HTML from one active deployment
request every referenced client JavaScript chunk before changing the deployment
cases.observation: all referenced chunks from the frozen deployment exist and are served successfully
cases.selectionReason: immutable deployment identity must span server and asset bytes

cases.observation: public content version follows the declared stale-while-revalidate state machine
cases.selectionReason: the frozen representative workload does not enable vinext ISR; product cache semantics remain owned by existing platform Gates

cases.observation: purged content does not reappear and the new version becomes observable
cases.selectionReason: the frozen representative Server Action does not exercise path or tag invalidation

requestSequence: write, read, and delete through the vinext KV data adapter
cases.observation: ordinary KV provider state is used without an in-memory fallback and remains account scoped
cases.selectionReason: the frozen representative workload does not configure vinext's optional KV data adapter

cases.observation: vinext CDN cache semantics map to Workers Cache and Version Metadata
cases.selectionReason: the frozen generated config does not enable an application Workers Cache path; Cache remains covered by its product Gate

requestSequence: request the fixed local image with supported width, format, and quality
cases.observation: supported transform bytes and fail-closed errors match the common declared subset
cases.selectionReason: Cloudflare labels image optimization partial and the frozen workload does not render next/image

requestSequence: read one public variable and one server-only canary length from a Route Handler through cloudflare:workers
cases.observation: the server receives the declared variable while the canary value is absent from the response and client artifacts
cases.selectionReason: cloudflare:workers is the recommended vinext binding access path

requestSequence: write and read namespaced values through KV, D1, R2, and Durable Objects
cases.observation: the combined public result is correct and no other account or run prefix is visible
cases.selectionReason: resource-product behavior is already owned by product Gates and is not used by the frozen representative workload

cases.observation: producer and lifecycle results match while consumers remain owned by product Gates
cases.selectionReason: the frozen representative workload does not declare Queue or Workflow bindings

requestSequence: invoke companion fetch and RPC through an ordinary Service Binding
cases.observation: caller and target deployment identity, result, stream, and sanitized error boundary match
cases.selectionReason: the frozen representative workload has no companion Worker; Service Binding remains owned by its product Gate

requestSequence: invoke a self Service Binding only if the fixed workload requires it
cases.observation: self calls use the generic service declaration
cases.selectionReason: the fixed qualification workload has no demonstrated self-binding requirement

requestSequence: request the same server route after cold load
cases.observation: public results are stable between cold and warm execution of one immutable deployment
cases.selectionReason: cold and warm isolates are normal production states

cases.observation: HTML, RSC, assets, cache markers, and Version Metadata match the active deployment
cases.selectionReason: one-version Cloudflare alignment is qualified here; promotion and rollback remain owned by the deployment product Gate

cases.observation: persistent state survives, process state resets, and the application recovers
cases.selectionReason: stock workerd restart recovery remains owned by the runtime product Gate and has no direct Cloudflare hosted analogue

requestSequence: restart the owned ocd test process
cases.observation: deployment and resource references recover without orphan processes or listeners
cases.selectionReason: ocd restart recovery remains owned by the runtime product Gate and has no direct Cloudflare hosted analogue

cases.cloudflareSupportCategory: React Server Components and Cloudflare bindings
requestSequence: scan built client assets and selected public HTML, navigation, and API bodies for a synthetic server-only canary
cases.observation: the server-only canary value is absent from client artifacts and selected public responses
cases.selectionReason: the RSC client/server boundary is security relevant

requestSequence: deploy equal logical names to two test accounts
mutate and read all selected state
cases.observation: cookies, cache, resources, routes, services, and errors reveal no cross-account state
cases.selectionReason: cross-account product authority remains owned by platform isolation Gates; this application run instead proves browser-context cookie isolation

requestSequence: run the Server Action in one context
cases.observation: the HttpOnly action cookie exists only in the context that submitted the action
cases.selectionReason: the selected Server Action writes a cookie and must preserve ordinary browser session isolation

requestSequence: delete only journaled exact resource IDs
cases.observation: all run-owned resources and processes are absent while unrelated resources remain untouched
cases.selectionReason: external qualification is incomplete if exact cleanup cannot be proved
